name: Shift_alphabet
short_desc: Caesar-cipher shift: shift each alpha char by n positions, preserve case.
description:
Given a string `s` and an integer `n`, shift each alphabetic character
in the string by `n` positions in the alphabet.

The function must:
  -> Preserve case (lowercase and uppercase handled separately).
  -> Wrap around the alphabet (e.g. 'z' + 1 -> 'a').
  -> Leave non-alphabetic characters unchanged.
  -> Support positive and negative shifts.

Function signature:
  def Shift_alphabet(s: str, n: int) -> str

Examples:
  Shift_alphabet("abz", 1)        -> "bca"
  Shift_alphabet("AbZ", 1)        -> "BcA"
  Shift_alphabet("Hello World!", 3) -> "Khoor Zruog!"
  Shift_alphabet("bca", -1)       -> "abz"
  Shift_alphabet("abc", 26)       -> "abc"
  Shift_alphabet("xyz", 3)        -> "abc"
  Shift_alphabet("", 10)          -> ""
  Shift_alphabet("12345", 4)      -> "12345"
prototype: def Shift_alphabet(s: str, n: int) -> str:
notes: Non-alphabetic characters (digits, spaces, punctuation) pass through unchanged.
